# Brain-wallet auditor — live-blockchain audit findings

**Status:** running iterations. This document is regenerated by
`tools/brain-wallet-auditor/examples/consolidate_btc_findings.py`
after each completed round.

## Methodology

* Tool: `tools/brain-wallet-auditor/` (this repo).
* Candidates: publicly-published weak-password / brain-wallet research
  dictionaries — *no* targeted attacks on specific wallets, *no*
  generative attempts at finding hits.
* Per candidate: derive both compressed and uncompressed
  SHA256-brainwallet Bitcoin addresses, query `blockstream.info`'s
  free public read-only API for current and lifetime balances.

## Ethical scope

This is a **read-only research audit**. The scripts here do not
export private keys, do not construct transactions, do not move
funds. If a currently-funded address appears below, only the
*passphrase owner* is morally and legally entitled to recover it.
Sweeping a brain wallet you don't own is theft and (in most
jurisdictions) wire fraud. See `tools/brain-wallet-auditor/README.md`.
